0335__L9_FN1_155__740F6782.mp3.translation: 他们从四面八方过来了！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 他们从四面八方过来了！

0336__L9_FN2_156__0861EE04.mp3.asr_text: They're in the church grounds now! Hold them back!
0336__L9_FN2_156__0861EE04.mp3.translation: 他们进教堂院子了！挡住他们！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 他们进教堂院子了！挡住他们！

0338__L9_MAD_118__A18E8D70.mp3.asr_text: Sharp, get on the back line.
0338__L9_MAD_118__A18E8D70.mp3.note: back line疑似back, lad；AM可佐证上车后部的口令，仅修正断词。

0339__L9_FN1_78__9A86C28C.mp3.translation: 弟兄们，见到你们太好了！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 弟兄们，见到你们太好了！

0340__L9_FN2_79__027606EC.mp3.asr_text: Can't believe you came for us!
0340__L9_FN2_79__027606EC.mp3.translation: 真没想到你们会来救我们！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 真没想到你们会来救我们！

0341__L9_MAD_80__742F445C.mp3.asr_text: No problem, lads. Where's Captain Randall?
0341__L9_MAD_80__742F445C.mp3.translation: 没事，弟兄们。兰德尔上尉在哪儿？

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 没事，弟兄们。兰德尔上尉在哪儿？

0343__L9_FN2_82__03C83B04.mp3.asr_text: He's taking a bullet in his leg though, Sarge.
0343__L9_FN2_82__03C83B04.mp3.translation: 不过中士，他腿上中了一枪。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 不过中士，他腿上中了一枪。

0346__L9_TAY_21__9D7B0E47.mp3.asr_text: Sharp! What are you waiting for? Get over there!

0347__L9_CPT_132__684946FF.mp3.asr_text: Fine work, Sergeant! My thanks to you and your men! I'll make sure command hear of this!
0347__L9_CPT_132__684946FF.mp3.translation: 干得好，中士！谢谢你和你的弟兄们。我一定向指挥部报告！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 干得好，中士！谢谢你和你的弟兄们。我一定向指挥部报告！

0348__L9_MAD_133__A4B1C929.mp3.asr_text: Just doing our bit, sir. Just doing our bit.
0348__L9_MAD_133__A4B1C929.mp3.translation: 分内的事，长官，分内的事。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 分内的事，长官，分内的事。

0350__L9_TAY_143__E244A024.mp3.asr_text: Dammit! Sorry, sir! I lost control on that bend!
0350__L9_TAY_143__E244A024.mp3.translation: 干！抱歉，长官，过那个弯时没控制住！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 干！抱歉，长官，过那个弯时没控制住！

0351__L9_MAD_144__A674B949.mp3.asr_text: We'll discuss the technicalities later, Taylor. Just get us out of here!
0351__L9_MAD_144__A674B949.mp3.translation: 技术问题回头再聊，泰勒。先带我们离开这儿！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 技术问题回头再聊，泰勒。先带我们离开这儿！

0352__L9_MAD_145__A682D0CA.mp3.asr_text: Shut up, keep us covered, lad!
0352__L9_MAD_145__A682D0CA.mp3.note: Shut up疑似Sharpe人名，AM可佐证，译为夏普而非闭嘴。

0353__L9_TAY_146__E26EE6A7.mp3.asr_text: The wheels is just spinning! It's stuck!

0356__L9_TAY_0__80D6F764.mp3.asr_text: So the captain's holed up at the church, pinned down, and we're going in to get him out, right?
0356__L9_TAY_0__80D6F764.mp3.translation: 所以说，上尉被困在教堂里，我们要冲进去把他带出来，对吧？

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 所以说，上尉被困在教堂里，我们要冲进去把他带出来，对吧？

0357__L9_MAD_1__1C232989.mp3.asr_text: That's about the size of it, Taylor.
0357__L9_MAD_1__1C232989.mp3.translation: 差不多就这么回事，泰勒。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 差不多就这么回事，泰勒。

0358__L9_TAY_2__80F32666.mp3.asr_text: Ha! You reckon we'll get medals?
0358__L9_TAY_2__80F32666.mp3.translation: 哈！你说会给我们发勋章吗？

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 哈！你说会给我们发勋章吗？

0359__L9_MAD_3__1C3F588B.mp3.asr_text: Knowing the captain will be lucky to get a handshake, lad.
0359__L9_MAD_3__1C3F588B.mp3.translation: 就上尉那脾气，能握个手就算不错了，小子。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 就上尉那脾气，能握个手就算不错了，小子。

0360__L9_TAY_4__810F5568.mp3.asr_text: There's the church spire behind those buildings.
0360__L9_TAY_4__810F5568.mp3.translation: 那些楼后面就是教堂尖顶。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 那些楼后面就是教堂尖顶。

0363__L9_TAY_23__9D973D49.mp3.note: Sherry疑似Jerry误识别，战场口语省略称呼。

0364__L9_MAD_127__A3354E8E.mp3.asr_text: Taylor, they blocked the road. You'll have to go cross terrain.
0364__L9_MAD_127__A3354E8E.mp3.translation: 泰勒，路被堵了，要绕到野地里去。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 泰勒，路被堵了，要绕到野地里去。

0365__L9_MAD_128__A343660F.mp3.asr_text: Taylor, you buck, get off the road!
0365__L9_MAD_128__A343660F.mp3.translation: 泰勒，你这傻子！离开公路！
0365__L9_MAD_128__A343660F.mp3.note: you buck疑似you berk，AM可佐证，按笨蛋处理。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 泰勒，你这傻子！离开公路！

0366__L9_MAD_129__A3517D90.mp3.asr_text: Go straight through the fence, Taylor!

0367__L9_TAY_130__E0658102.mp3.asr_text: Hold on to your hats, lads!

0371__L9_MAD_157__A853D86B.mp3.asr_text: They coming from the south now, Sharp. Have at them, lad.
0371__L9_MAD_157__A853D86B.mp3.translation: 夏普，他们又从南边来了。挡住他们！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 夏普，他们又从南边来了。挡住他们！

0373__L9_FN2_83__03D65285.mp3.note: Maddox/Maddock统一采用现有头顶人名译法马多克。

0374__L9_CPT_84__179E8629.mp3.asr_text: Glad you could make it, Sergeant.
0374__L9_CPT_84__179E8629.mp3.translation: 中士，很高兴你能赶过来。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 中士，很高兴你能赶过来。

0375__L9_MAD_85__7475B9E1.mp3.asr_text: So am I, sir. What's the situation?
0375__L9_MAD_85__7475B9E1.mp3.translation: 我也是，长官。现在什么情况？

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 我也是，长官。现在什么情况？

0376__L9_CPT_86__17BAB52B.mp3.asr_text: Jerry got lucky and caught me with a blasted bullet.
0376__L9_CPT_86__17BAB52B.mp3.translation: 德国人走运，让我挨了一发该死的子弹。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 德国人走运，让我挨了一发该死的子弹。

0379__L9_MAD_89__74AE17E5.mp3.asr_text: We can't hold out forever up here, sir. Not with so many Germans still in town.
0379__L9_MAD_89__74AE17E5.mp3.translation: 长官，镇上还有这么多德军，我们不可能一直守在这儿。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 长官，镇上还有这么多德军，我们不可能一直守在这儿。

0380__L9_CPT_90__191B00C4.mp3.asr_text: Understood, Sergeant. Just make sure you get the men out of here.
0380__L9_CPT_90__191B00C4.mp3.translation: 明白，中士。你要把弟兄们带出去。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 明白，中士。你要把弟兄们带出去。

0381__L9_MAD_91__75F2347C.mp3.asr_text: So there's no way me and the lads are leaving you behind. If you can't walk, then I'll find us some transport.
0381__L9_MAD_91__75F2347C.mp3.translation: 长官，我和弟兄们绝不会丢下你。走不了，我就去找辆车。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 长官，我和弟兄们绝不会丢下你。走不了，我就去找辆车。

0382__L9_CPT_92__19372FC6.mp3.asr_text: We had to abandon two jeeps nearby. They'd had it, I'm afraid.
0382__L9_CPT_92__19372FC6.mp3.translation: 附近丢了两辆吉普，不过恐怕已经废了。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 附近丢了两辆吉普，不过恐怕已经废了。

0383__L9_FN3_94__6D7A6F84.mp3.asr_text: Sir, they were knackered. There's no way we can drive them.
0383__L9_FN3_94__6D7A6F84.mp3.translation: 长官，那车都坏完了，根本开不了。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 长官，那车都坏完了，根本开不了。

0384__L9_TAY_95__A9A558A4.mp3.asr_text: I was a mechanic back in civvy life, sir. I bet I could have him going in a jiffy.
0384__L9_TAY_95__A9A558A4.mp3.translation: 长官，我当兵前是干汽修的，说不定一会儿就能修好。
0384__L9_TAY_95__A9A558A4.mp3.note: him疑似them，指待修的吉普车；不额外引入人物。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 长官，我当兵前是干汽修的，说不定一会儿就能修好。

0385__L9_MAD_96__7638AA01.mp3.asr_text: Glad to know you're good for something, Taylor. Get on it, lad.
0385__L9_MAD_96__7638AA01.mp3.translation: 泰勒，总算知道你还有点用。去吧。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 泰勒，总算知道你还有点用。去吧。

0386__L9_CPT_97__197DA54B.mp3.asr_text: If we can just hold Jerry until they come back, we might have a shot at this, Sergeant Maddock.
0386__L9_CPT_97__197DA54B.mp3.translation: 马多克中士，只要能撑到他们回来，就有希望了。
0386__L9_CPT_97__197DA54B.mp3.note: 人名沿用现有统一译文马多克。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 马多克中士，只要能撑到他们回来，就有希望了。

0387__L9_MAD_98__7654D903.mp3.asr_text: Understood, sir. Sharp, keep your eyes peeled and shoot anything not in a British uniform.
0387__L9_MAD_98__7654D903.mp3.translation: 明白，长官。夏普，盯紧点，认清英军制服，别让敌人靠近。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 明白，长官。夏普，盯紧点，认清英军制服，别让敌人靠近。

0389__L9_MAD_64__70FDF122.mp3.asr_text: Looks like our boys are in trouble up there!
0389__L9_MAD_64__70FDF122.mp3.translation: 咱们的弟兄在上面有麻烦了！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 咱们的弟兄在上面有麻烦了！

0391__L9_MAD_26__6A46BDA8.mp3.asr_text: Step on it, Sharp! Get down that street and knock out the half-track!
0391__L9_MAD_26__6A46BDA8.mp3.translation: 夏普，快点！沿街下去，干掉那辆半履带车！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 夏普，快点！沿街下去，干掉那辆半履带车！

0392__L9_MAD_12__68598705.mp3.asr_text: Come on, Sharp. We gotta flank that bloody half-track. If those lads down there are in for it.
0392__L9_MAD_12__68598705.mp3.translation: 夏普，快，要绕到那辆半履带车侧面，不然下面的弟兄就危险了。
0392__L9_MAD_12__68598705.mp3.note: ASR连句关系疑似if/不然误识别，按下方己方士兵面临火力威胁理解。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 夏普，快，要绕到那辆半履带车侧面，不然下面的弟兄就危险了。

0395__L9_MAD_126__A327370D.mp3.asr_text: Sharp! Earn your king's shilling, lad! Give us some supporting fire!
0395__L9_MAD_126__A327370D.mp3.translation: 夏普，别白领军饷！给我们火力支援！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 夏普，别白领军饷！给我们火力支援！

0396__L9_MAD_160__A9A60C83.mp3.asr_text: Taylor, get a charge on that bridge.

0399__L9_TAY_45__A11D1D89.mp3.asr_text: Damn! That's a Panzer! Get in cover!

0404__L9_MAD_24__6A2A8EA6.mp3.asr_text: Nicely done, lads. Let's get through here. Taylor, the door, please.
0404__L9_MAD_24__6A2A8EA6.mp3.translation: 干得好，弟兄们，穿过去。泰勒，开个门。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 干得好，弟兄们，穿过去。泰勒，开个门。

0405__L9_MAD_19__68BC2B8C.mp3.asr_text: Sharp, Taylor, get across the street and bung a charge on that half-track.
0405__L9_MAD_19__68BC2B8C.mp3.translation: 夏普、泰勒，穿过街道，给那辆半履带车装上炸药。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 夏普、泰勒，穿过街道，给那辆半履带车装上炸药。

0406__L9_TAY_20__9D6CF6C6.mp3.asr_text: Okay, Sarge. Come at sharp. Let's get to it.
0406__L9_TAY_20__9D6CF6C6.mp3.note: Come at sharp疑似Come on, Sharpe，按招呼夏普行动处理。

0407__L9_MAD_15__6883CD88.mp3.asr_text: Damn it! They've got us pinned!

0411__L9_MAD_116__A1725E6E.mp3.asr_text: You wait ages for one and two come along at once, eh?
0411__L9_MAD_116__A1725E6E.mp3.translation: 等半天一辆没有，一来就是两辆，对吧？

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 等半天一辆没有，一来就是两辆，对吧？

0412__L9_MAD_8__1C85CE10.mp3.asr_text: Hell, Jerry's a mine the road!
0412__L9_MAD_8__1C85CE10.mp3.note: a mine疑似have mined，按道路埋雷处理。

0414__L9_MAD_27__6A54D529.mp3.asr_text: Most of the roads are blocked with debris. We'll have to pick our way through to the church.
0414__L9_MAD_27__6A54D529.mp3.translation: 大半道路都被瓦砾堵了，要找路穿过去，到教堂去。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 大半道路都被瓦砾堵了，要找路穿过去，到教堂去。

0415__L9_TAY_28__9DDDB2CE.mp3.note: Jennings疑似Jerries，按敌军喊话理解，待听音。

0416__L9_MAD_29__6A71042B.mp3.asr_text: Keep moving, we can handle him!
0416__L9_MAD_29__6A71042B.mp3.translation: 继续前进，对付得了他们！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 继续前进，对付得了他们！

0417__L9_FN1_105__6B872C67.mp3.asr_text: Stone me! They've got armor down there now!
0417__L9_FN1_105__6B872C67.mp3.translation: 天哪！他们连坦克都开来了！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 天哪！他们连坦克都开来了！
